description: Self-hosted Renovate (run-llama/platform renovate.yml). charts/llamacloud is the BYOC chart customers install, so every chart change waits for approval on the dependency dashboard and ships only with a chart version bump, a changelog entry and the 10-day customer notice. Nothing automerges here: this repo has no automated reviewer.

packageRules.description: One PR per manager for minor, patch and digest updates
Some registries publish no release timestamps for digests; do not hold those updates forever
All non-major GitHub Actions updates in one PR

The BYOC chart ships to customer installs: every dependency and image update waits for approval. charts/llamacloud is a copy of platform's infra/charts/llamacloud that each BYOC release overwrites (utils/byoc/update-public-helm-chart-repo.sh), so a change made here alone is lost at the next release.
prBodyNotes: BYOC chart: make the same change in platform's infra/charts/llamacloud or the next BYOC release overwrites it, bump the llamacloud chart version and CHANGELOG in this PR; tenants upgrade after the 10-day customer notice.

packageRules.description: Temporal server: the subchart and the admin-tools image move together, one minor at a time (schema migration on every install)
Runtime versions (setup-python and friends) wait for approval
Our own images and charts move with each BYOC release, not with Renovate
